cohort: The cohort consisted of 8720 neonates whose umbilical cord blood TSH levels were measured.
finding: A cord blood TSH value greater than 20 mIU/ml can safely be used as an effective screening tool for congenital hypothyroidism, with an observed incidence of 1 in 2180.
followup_time: 7 days for a subset of neonates with elevated TSH for diagnostic confirmation; initial measurement at birth.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at birth (umbilical cord blood) over an eight-year period.
gest_age: After 28 weeks of gestation (including term gestation)
